Subject: Application for Personal Loan

Dear Loan Officer,

I am writing to formally apply for a personal loan. My name is Andrew Cross, and I reside at 567 Antonio Forges, New Antoniostad, WV 71119, where I own my home (with an outstanding mortgage balance of $120,000).

To provide full transparency regarding my financial history, I filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy (case number WV-2023-0456) on June 15, 2023, and received my discharge on October 1, 2023. I have been working to rebuild my financial stability since then, and I currently maintain a monthly cash reserve of $10,000.

I would also like to disclose that I have a pending legal case (case number WV-2024-1122), which carries a potential liability of $25,000, of which $15,000 is covered by my insurance. I have placed $5,000 in escrow and maintain dedicated reserves to address this matter responsibly.

Given my homeownership, current reserves, and steady income, I am confident in my ability to meet the repayment terms. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss available loan options, interest rates, and the application requirements. I am happy to provide any additional documentation, including details of my bankruptcy discharge and employment information, to support my application.

Thank you for considering my request. I look forward to your response and to scheduling a meeting at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Andrew Cross
567 Antonio Forges, New Antoniostad, WV 71119
